verdict.rationale: HeyGen's developer site lists a CLI alongside REST and MCP ("REST, CLI, and MCP"), so an official CLI is claimed first-party. That single headline mention is the only evidence: nothing describes its commands, installation, auth flow or agent-oriented usage, and no hands-on or community report confirms it. Missing for 10: CLI documentation (install, commands, auth), evidence of AI-native or scriptable workflows via the CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
